title: Claim Envelope
description: What a fleet agent submits to the Verification Node (governance ceiling) before any output ships, enshrines, or spends. The node NEVER trusts the envelope; it verifies asserted_flows against evidence_refs (the Phantom-Aid gate).

claim.description: The single assertion being submitted for verdict.

author_did.description: Lattice identity of the submitting agent.

thread_ref.description: Originating thread / run id for audit.

grounding.description: canonical_id(s) of the Grounding Records this claim leans on (the floor it stands on).

actuation_class.description: What the claim will DO. Drives the Trust-Rubric tier and the RED escalation.

asserted_flows.description: What the agent claims happened across the four SFI flows. Each is a claim to be verified, not accepted.

evidence_refs.description: Externally checkable pointers backing the asserted flows (git sha, endpoint URL, file hash, txn id). The node reads/probes these.

reversible.description: Is the action reversible? Irreversible + high-blast forces RED escalation regardless of gate pass.

ethical_terms.description: Value/ethical terms the resolver REFUSED to ground. Surfaced here so the ceiling governs them (Abu), never the floor.
